evidence.observation: Reboiler reads 433.8→442.7 °C, physically implausible and monotonically ramping while all column temps stay ~64-74 °C
Reflux and distillate flows essentially zero throughout, FYI702 = 0; no material traffic in the column
Pressure drops flat (~0.7 / ~2.9 mbar) with PY23 steady at 500 mbar, consistent with negligible vapour traffic
Slow cyclic oscillation of mid-column temperatures with no net separation profile developing
